newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Amplico Life H1 net falls to PLN 6.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish Amplico Life H1 net falls to PLN 6.8 mln.

text.p: Polish insurer Amplico Life SA's first half net profit fell to 6.83 million zlotys from 9.62 million zlotys in the same period last year, the firm said in a statement on Monday.

Amplico Life, 55-percent owned by U.S.-based American Insurance Group (AIG) and 45-percent by Polish state-owned Bank Pekao SA, said its technical result fell to 1.7 million zlotys from 6.2 million in the first half of 1996.
Amplico said net profit and technical result were hurt as technical insurance reserves rose two and a half times from last year's first half to 240.3 million zlotys.
The firm said gross premiums in the first half ending July 31 rose to 160 million zlotys from 90.5 million in first-half 1996.
It said investment revenues rose in the first half to 22.7 million zlotys from 10.9 million zlotys while investment rose to 289.3 million zlotys from 123.2 million.
This year Amplico Life changed the start of its financial year to December 1 from January 1.
